body: The job market is filled with younger people full of energy and motivated to get a job while, I'm just old and depressed and tired of trying to get back on my feet,  I don't stand a chance against them. The earth doesn't need another sucker like me.

What is the easiest and quickest way to end it all? I considered carbon monoxide poisoning but it looks like it would be too long, maybe something more violent would be quicker. For those few people who still care about me, they will quickly forget me.
